verdict.rationale: Apify docs explicitly describe publishing Actors to Apify Store and earning passive income (apify-docs-5), backed by a large marketplace with 64,279 Actors (apify-docs-12), sharing/permissions controls (apify-docs-9), and developer tooling to build Actors (apify-docs-1, apify-docs-33). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of actual revenue payouts or developer earnings testimonials.
